extensionDescription.message: Open tabs in the background that only load when you select them – for bookmark folders, links and optionally middle-click.
extensionDescription.description: Short description of the add-on (max. 132 characters).

menuOpenLink.description: Context menu entry on a link.

menuOpenBookmark.description: Context menu entry on a single bookmark.

menuOpenFolder.description: Context menu entry on a bookmark folder (counterpart to Firefox's 'Open All in Tabs').

optMiddleClick.message: Middle-click on a link opens a lazy tab

optCtrlClick.description: Settings page: checkbox label. On macOS this is Cmd+click.

optCtrlClickHint.message: Off: Ctrl+click behaves as usual in Firefox.
optCtrlClickHint.description: Settings page: hint below the Ctrl+click checkbox.

optContextMenuHint.description: Settings page: general hint at the bottom.
